# eclipse-codegen

[All servers](../mcp-tools.md)

Version: 1.0.0. Tools: 3.

## generateGettersSetters

Generate getter and/or setter methods for fields in a Java class. This is one of the most frequent boilerplate code generation operations. The tool will automatically detect field types, generate appropriate method signatures, and avoid creating duplicate methods.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/User.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| className | string | String | No | The name of the class within the file. Optional if the file contains only one class. |
| fieldNames | string | String | No | Comma-separated list of field names to generate methods for. If not specified, all fields will be processed. |
| generateGetters | string | Boolean | No | Whether to generate getter methods. Defaults to true. |
| generateSetters | string | Boolean | No | Whether to generate setter methods. Defaults to true. |
| insertionPoint | string | String | No | Where to insert the generated methods: 'end' (default) to add at the end of the class, or a specific line number |

## generateToStringEqualsHashCode

Generate toString(), equals(), and/or hashCode() methods for a Java class based on its fields. These are standard methods used for object representation, equality comparison, and hash-based collections. The tool will generate methods following Java best practices and avoid creating duplicates.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/User.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| className | string | String | No | The name of the class within the file. Optional if the file contains only one class. |
| fieldNames | string | String | No | Comma-separated list of field names to include in the generated methods. If not specified, all fields will be included. |
| generateToString | string | Boolean | No | Whether to generate toString() method. Defaults to true. |
| generateEquals | string | Boolean | No | Whether to generate equals() method. Defaults to true. |
| generateHashCode | string | Boolean | No | Whether to generate hashCode() method. Defaults to true. |

## implementOverrideMethods

Implement or override methods from superclass or interfaces. This tool finds unimplemented abstract methods and generates skeleton implementations with appropriate @Override annotations and TODO comments. Useful when implementing interfaces or extending abstract classes.

Input schema type: object.

| Parameter | Schema type | Java type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| projectName | string | String | No | The name of the project containing the Java file. Optional if file path is unique across projects or starts with /projectName/ |
| filePath | string | String | Yes | The path to the Java file relative to the project root (e.g., 'src/com/example/MyService.java') or absolute path starting with /projectName/ |
| className | string | String | No | The name of the class within the file. Optional if the file contains only one class. |
| methodNames | string | String | No | Comma-separated list of specific method names to implement. If not specified, all unimplemented abstract methods will be generated. |
